chunks: And it has been narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
"When you leave your home, shorten your prayers until you return to it."

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: al-Sadiq, Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: When should a traveler shorten salat (prayer) according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the traveler’s salat (prayer): when a person departs from his home, he performs shortened prayers during the period of travel until he returns home. It reflects the fiqh principle of qaṣr for travel in Shia jurisprudence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1267 - It has been narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"When you leave your home, shorten your prayers until you return to it."
